Marcus is invented. This is the product we're building.

6:30 AM

The clips from last night, already in.

Marcus fixes kids' bikes for free in his street on Saturdays. He films bits on his phone and shares them to True Convo. By morning they're on the Mac, transcribed, labelled "unchecked".

6:40 AM

The story, told his way.

He talks for three minutes about the girl with the pink bike. True Convo turns it into the week's three posts, in his words, because it has learned how he talks.

6:50 AM

Nothing is posted. The PA proposes; Marcus decides. A correction becomes the default next time.

9:00 PM

No frontier model required.

Everything today ran on a model on a second-hand Mac. Nothing went to the cloud, because nothing needed to.

What it costs to start.

Nothing, to begin. A model on the Mac he already has. No subscription, no account, no card.
His story stays his. His clips, his words, his ledger, on his machine. Nothing posted or sent without his yes.
Straight answers. The PA says what a podcast costs in hours before it says anything encouraging. Showing isn't permitting; suggesting isn't pushing.
Money goes to him. Giving goes to an account he already has. Cloudwork takes nothing.
Open core. Copy it, change it, label it as your own.
Leave any time. Export everything in a form that works without us.

Not on your own

More than software.

True Convo is meant to come with people: lessons in plain words, others in the same spot as Marcus, and the apps and templates they make and share.

ComingLearn

Plain lessons on running a fundraiser honestly, from people who have done it.

ComingPeople

Small causes helping each other find their first thousand people, without buying them.

ComingShared

Donation pages and volunteer rotas that members built and left free to copy.

None of this exists yet. It's what we hope to build with the first people who use True Convo, and we'll say so plainly until it's real.

11:00 PM

Three posts, a page, a grant. All his.

The bike thing has a page, a plan for the week, a sponsor and a grant form waiting for his signature. All of it on a second-hand Mac that sent nothing to the cloud today. No account with us. No ads. Nothing sold on.

Where this stands. True Convo is in development and not out yet. Built so far: the pill, dictation at the cursor, the Desk with a model on the Mac, encrypted storage, and the first engines for lists, habits, tasks, the agenda, mail, the calendar, time, sources and the capture inbox. Being built now: the PA, the iPhone, sync and the first-run guide. The voice module, the site builder, the checkup and building his own apps come after launch. The lessons, the community and the shared library are a plan too; none of them exist yet. Marcus and everything on this page are invented to show the plan; the tests decide the order.
